gc-01.description:
Arcus Labs is a 60-person company building revenue infrastructure for B2B software teams. We are hiring a Business Systems Engineer to own the architecture of our CRM and the data model underneath it.

You will own the HubSpot platform end to end, from object model design to the integrations that keep it honest. You will design and maintain the data model that connects product usage, billing and the CRM, and you will write the Python services that move that data.

We hire anywhere in the Americas, including Brazil, and we are fully remote. The role reports to the Head of Revenue Operations.

Requirements: five or more years working on internal systems; strong SQL; comfort owning an API integration end to end. English is required for daily work; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.

Compensation is USD 120,000 to USD 150,000 per year plus equity. We review bands annually and publish them internally.

gc-03.description:
Northbeam Logistics is hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer for our Customer Engineering team.

You will build and ship the integrations that connect our platform to a customer's warehouse systems. You will work alongside the account team, but you are not a pre-sales resource: the deliverable is working software in a customer's environment.

This role requires you to be legally authorised to work in the United States and to be based in the Bay Area; we do not sponsor visas and cannot employ contractors outside the US. We are in the office three days a week.

The base salary range for this role is USD 165,000 to USD 195,000.
